given: a SKU's detail view is open and its location entries have combined tracking codes recorded
when: the operator reads a location entry
then: that entry shows the record's tracking code
architectural_notes: E2E: the tracking code is a stored column on stock_records surfaced through the same read path (app/repositories to app/services to app/routes JSON boundary) and rendered per-entry by the client/ React detail component. No new service logic beyond including the field in the read projection; the boundary passes the value through in JSON and the SPA renders it in the location entry. Verified by the real-branch integration suite (a row with a tracking code) plus the client component test.

independence.rationale: AC1 covers that the per-location entries (location + quantity) render at all; AC2 covers the distinct outcome that each entry surfaces its tracking code, which can break (code missing from the entry) while the location and quantity still render, and vice versa.
